// Generator for go_rules.json. To regenerate, copy into internal/domain as
// zz_rustrules_test.go and run from the repo root:
//
//	RECUR_RUST_RULES=$PWD/crates/domain/tests/fixtures/go_rules.json \
//	  go test ./internal/domain -run TestDumpRustRules -count=1
//
// then delete the copy. Rows are [cadence, cron, date, time, zone, after,
// want] where want is the RFC3339 UTC result, "" for no occurrence, or "!"
// for an error.
package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestDumpRustRules(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("RECUR_RUST_RULES")
	if path == "" {
		t.Skip()
	}
	afters := []string{"2026-02-28T23:59:59.9Z", "2026-03-08T06:59:30Z", "2026-03-29T00:30:00Z", "2026-04-04T15:00:00Z", "2026-10-25T00:59:59Z", "2026-11-01T05:59:00Z"}
	zones := []string{"UTC", "America/New_York", "Australia/Lord_Howe", "America/Havana", "America/Sao_Paulo", "Pacific/Chatham"}
	crons := []string{
		"* * * * *", "*/7 * * * *", "0 0 * * *", "30 2 * * *", "30 1 * * *", "0 0 31 * *", "0 12 * * SUN",
		"15 10 1 */2 *", "0 0 1,15 * MON", "5-10/2 3 * * *", "0 9 * JAN,MAR MON", "0 0 29 FEB *",
		"*/10 * * * * *", "30 */20 * * * *", "@yearly", "@monthly", "@weekly", "@daily", "@hourly",
		"@every 90m", "@every 1.5s", "@every 36h", "CRON_TZ=Asia/Tokyo 0 9 * * *", "TZ=Europe/London 30 1 * * *",
		"0 0 ? * 0-6", "59 23 31 12 *", "0 0 30 FEB *", "0 25 * * *", "1-2-3 * * * *", "* * * * * * *",
		"0 0 * * 7", "@every 0s", "@every -1h", "@biweekly", "CRON_TZ=Bogus/Zone 0 0 * * *",
		"0 0 */0 * *", "x y z w v", "0 0 1 jan-mar *", "0 0 L * *", "0 0 1,,15 * *",
	}
	clocks := []string{"00:00", "01:30", "02:30", "9:05", "12:00", "23:59", "24:00", "1:5", "07:60"}
	dates := []string{"2026-03-08", "2026-03-29", "2026-11-01", "2026-04-05", "2026-02-29", "2028-02-29", "2026-1-01"}
	var rows [][]string
	for _, z := range zones {
		for i, a := range afters {
			for _, c := range crons {
				rows = append(rows, []string{"cron", c, "", "", z, a})
			}
			for _, clock := range clocks {
				rows = append(rows, []string{"daily", "", "", clock, z, a}, []string{"weekdays", "", "", clock, z, a})
				if i < 2 {
					for _, d := range dates {
						rows = append(rows, []string{"once", "", d, clock, z, a})
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for i, r := range rows {
		after, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, r[5])
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		got, err := NextScheduledTime(ScheduledPrompt{Cadence: r[0], Cron: r[1], Date: r[2], Time: r[3], TimeZone: r[4]}, after)
		want := ""
		if err != nil {
			want = "!"
		} else if !got.IsZero() {
			want = got.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
		}
		rows[i] = append(r, want)
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"schedules": rows})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
